answer: Funding-graph tracing with burned entry fees: each new agent identity must burn a fee paid from an address with its own on-chain history, and the network traces where that coin came from. When dozens of identities trace back to one wallet, the ledger reads like a fable with every chapter by the same author, so the cluster shares one reward slot. Hiding the trail means a long voyage through mixers that charges a fee at every hop, and burned fees can't be melted down and recast like ferrous scrap. Each fake costs more than the share it could earn.
